allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Follow Alex Honnold as he attempts to become the first person to ever free solo climb Yosemite's 3,000 foot high El Capitan wall. With no ropes or safety gear, this would arguably be the greatest feat in rock climbing history.

facts.overview: Follow Alex Honnold as he attempts to become the first person to ever free solo climb Yosemite's 3,000 foot high El Capitan wall. With no ropes or safety gear, this would arguably be the greatest feat in rock climbing history.
facts.title: Free Solo

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Facing 3,000 feet of sheer granite without a single protective tether, how does a climber prepare for a feat where even the slightest slip is absolute?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Directors Jimmy Chin and Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi capture climber Alex Honnold as he prepares to scale Yosemite's 3,000-foot El Capitan wall entirely alone, attempting the massive vertical ascent without ropes.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: High-stakes, gripping, and deeply suspenseful; a demanding adventure documentary that pairs steady precision with vertigo-inducing tension.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: It translates an unthinkable physical feat into pure cinematic suspense, capturing sheer vertical scale alongside the singular focus demanded by an ascent with zero room for error.
